evidence.title: The Death Kiss
evidence.text: The Death Kiss is a 1932 American pre-Code mystery film starring David Manners as a crusading studio writer, Adrienne Ames as an actress, and Bela Lugosi as a studio manager.

evidence.title: The Death Kiss
evidence.text: The thriller features three leading players from the previous year's" Dracula"( Lugosi, Manners, and Edward Van Sloan), and was the first film directed by Edwin L. Marin.

evidence.title: The Death Kiss
evidence.text: The film was produced by KBS Productions at Tiffany Pictures and released by Sono Art- World Wide Pictures.

evidence.title: The Death Kiss
evidence.text: The film is currently in the public domain.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: Edwin L. Marin (February 21, 1899 – May 2, 1951) was an American film director who directed 58 films between 1932 and 1951, working with Randolph Scott, Anna May Wong, John Wayne, Peter Lorre, George Raft, Bela Lugosi, Judy Garland, Eddie Cantor, and Hoagy Carmichael, among many others.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: Marin was born in Jersey City, New Jersey, and died in Los Angeles, California.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: He was married to actress Ann Morriss.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: They had three children: Denis Anthony, Reese Andrew and Randi Alexandra.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: He studied at the University of Pennsylvania and broke into the industry as an assistant director at MGM.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: He was under contract to MGM for 15 years and RKO for five.

evidence.title: Edwin L. Marin
evidence.text: When he died he was under contract to Warner Bros.

evidence.title: Ben Palmer
evidence.text: Ben Palmer is a British film and television director who is known for being the director of" Bo' Selecta" and" The Inbetweeners".

evidence.title: Hassan Zee
evidence.text: Hassan Zee is a Pakistani- American film director who was born in Chakwal, Pakistan.

evidence.title: Catherine I of Russia
evidence.text: Catherine I( born, later known as Marta Samuilovna Skavronskaya; –) was the second wife of Peter the Great and Empress of Russia from 1725 until her death.

evidence.title: W. Augustus Barratt
evidence.text: W. Augustus Barratt( 1873- 1947) was a Scottish- born, later American, songwriter and musician.

evidence.title: Swapan Saha
evidence.text: Swapan Saha( born 10 January 1930 in Ajmer, Rajasthan, India) is an Indian Bengali film director, producer, story writer and score composer.

evidence.title: Achena Prem
evidence.text: Achena Prem is a 2011 Bengali film directed by Swapan Saha and produced under the banner of Maa Kali Films.

evidence.title: Achena Prem
evidence.text: The movie is an unofficial remake of hit Kannada movie" Mussanjemaatu".

evidence.title: Achena Prem
evidence.text: Surprisingly the fact that it is a remake of the Kannada movie has not been mentioned either on the Achena Prem's official website or in other reviews/ articles on the internet All Kannada songs from the original have been also retained in the movie.

evidence.title: Achena Prem
evidence.text: The song" Kar Mone te ki Swopno Thake" is the Bengali version of Kannada song" Enagali Munde Saagu Nee" and" Tomake Bhebe Mon" is the Bengali version of Kannada song" Ninna Nodalento".

evidence.title: Edward Yates
evidence.text: Edward J. Yates( September 16, 1918 – June 2, 2006) was an American television director who was the director of the ABC television program" American Bandstand" from 1952 until 1969.
